data.name: Sharvilash
data.gender_notes: Sharvilash is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sharvilash is a combination of two words - 'Sharva' and 'Ish', where 'Sharva' means God and 'Ish' means Lord. The name Sharvilash signifies the power and strength of the God. It is a name given to a child who is believed to be a warrior of God. The name Sharvilash carries the meaning “God's Warrior” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Sharvilash usually hope their child will grow to embody god's warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Sharvilash is believed to bring blessings of strength, power, and victory. It is a name for a child who is believed to have a strong spiritual connection with God.
data.etymology: Sharvilash belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvilash total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
